LanguageData.MooGirl_Slavegauntlet.description: A locking restraint glove used to securely fasten a Mugirl's fingers, significantly reducing her manipulation and fine motor skills. The gloves are equipped with a dedicated locking mechanism that can only be released using an [Exquisite Restraint Key].
LanguageData.MooGirl_Slavestockings.description: A special type of restraint stockings, shaped similarly to high heels but lacking heels, causing the wearer to walk unsteadily with noticeably reduced movement speed. The stockings are equipped with a dedicated locking mechanism that can only be released using an [Exquisite Restraint Key].
